effective_date: Upon full execution by all parties
payment_terms: Gross receipts are used first to pay business expenses. After expenses, the business keeps a 10% reserve. The remaining amount is paid out monthly to the parties according to the agreed ownership split, unless the parties later agree in writing to treat a contribution as a loan or to change the payout structure. Any spending above $500 needs both parties’ approval before payment is made.
purpose: Services relationship: operative commitments below follow your notes. The parties are starting and operating a mobile coffee cart together. party_a funded the trailer and machines, and those items stay party_a’s personal property unless the parties sign a written transfer. party_b will run the daily operations of the cart. The business ownership split is 60/40. Spending above $500 requires approval from both parties before it is made. Future cash put into the business is treated as a loan first unless the parties later agree in writing to convert it into ownership. The parties want a clear buyout path, with a first right to buy at fair market value based on trailing 6 months earnings or an independent appraisal. Monthly payouts are made after expenses and after keeping a 10% reserve. If a dispute comes up, the parties will try mediation first and then binding arbitration if mediation does not resolve it.
